note: Typed tool routes. One row per MCP server Forge knows how to route work to. Rows are host-neutral by construction: a row names the SERVER, never a host's spelling of its tool namespace. The host registry owns that spelling and composes the concrete namespace at render time, so adding a host never edits this file and adding a server never edits host code.
rules: Every id must match a dependency id in catalog.json. One dependency truth, not two.
A row grants tools only to an agent that declares the matching capability, and only on a host that provides every entry in requires_host_provides.
A row without a resolvable probe is not routable. Detection is never assumed from installation.
fallbacks must name the same route catalog.json declares for the dependency, so a missing server degrades instead of blocking.

probe_kinds.mcp-server-declared: The server id appears in an MCP client configuration the host declares in hosts/registry.json mcp.config_paths. Read-only: it inspects configuration and never starts, installs, or contacts a server.

lanes.ue.editor: Live Unreal editor session. Exclusive: native typed calls, live scripting, editor-closed commandlets and human editor work all contend for it.
lanes.dcc.authoring: External DCC authoring session. Runs concurrently with ue.editor because it writes intermediate assets, not the project.
